Title: Document 6
Content: Source: Saint Benedict of Palermo holding the infant Jesus, a statue from the Church of Our Lady of the Rosary of the Black People, Salvador, Brazil, circa `text(1750)`.

Benedict of Palermo was a saint of African ancestry who lived in Italy in the `text(sixteenth century)`. The Church of Our Lady of the Rosary of the Black People in Salvador was built by a religious brotherhood of enslaved and free African Brazilians.
